notes: V8 is built as a shared library (rusty_v8.dll + import lib) WITH its own bundled libc++ -- use_custom_libcxx stays on. An earlier plan set it false so V8 and Skia would share the MSVC STL, and this lock recorded that; it was measured infeasible on 2026-07-24 (clang-cl crashes on 32 torque-generated translation units, preceded by 78 -Wctad-maybe-unsupported errors, because Chromium compiles them with -D_HAS_EXCEPTIONS=0 and /std:c++23preview, which Microsoft's STL does not support). The Skia/V8 std::terminate collision is instead answered by the shared-library form keeping V8's libc++ internal. Note use_custom_libcxx is a cargo feature, not a GN argument: build.rs derives the GN value from CARGO_FEATURE_USE_CUSTOM_LIBCXX and overrides EXTRA_GN_ARGS, so it is recorded under cargo_features. component_kind, gn_args and cargo_features are Windows-specific extensions to the migo-v8-build-lock/v1 shape used by android-v8.lock.json.
